summary: Iteration 2: New reviewer data-management features tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (POST /api/students success/409/400; GET /api/students/import/template returns CSV with correct header; POST preview no-persist + summary counts; POST commit create-then-update idempotency (2nd import updates, 0 duplicates); POST /students/import/demo; POST /students/{id}/records appends + recomputes + audit; POST /students/{id}/records/import; GET /api/students-stats keys; audit-log reflects student-added; regression: Arjun profile intact + LLM /signals/{id}/explain still works). Frontend: Enter Demo login lands on dashboard; Students page Add Student flow (STU-UI-...) shows success + Open Student Profile CTA; student profile Add Academic Record shows 'Student audit updated' toast; Upload Records modal opens; Import modal shows Download Template + Use Demo Dataset + Dropzone; CSV upload renders 'Review Data Before Import' preview with 'New' tags; Commit fires success toast; Students search finds Arjun. HOWEVER — /api/dashboard entry point (Dashboard.jsx) is broken because /api/overview now returns 500 (IndexError) whenever ANY reviewer-created student (that lacks a full performance.series matching semesters) is in the DB.

critical.issue: IndexError: list index out of range at server.py line ~184 `perf[i] - base`. Reviewer-created / imported students created by _new_student_doc + add_student do NOT have performance.series with len == number of semesters (5). Once any such student exists in the DB, /api/overview 500s for every user and the Dashboard page hangs on skeleton loaders. Reproducible: POST /api/students {student_id, full_name} then GET /api/overview -> 500.

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard skeleton never resolves because /api/overview returns 500 (root cause: same as backend critical). Dashboard 'Students' section (Total/Added This Month/Active Signals/Require Review/Recent Activity) and 'Signals Requiring Attention' therefore not visible after any student add/import.

action_items: Fix /api/overview to tolerate students with short/missing performance.series. Guard: `perf = (s.get('performance') or {}).get('series') or []; if i >= len(perf): continue` — or precompute a padded series in _recompute_and_store so every student always has performance.series length == len(semesters).
Consider making _new_student_doc / add_student initialize `performance = {'series': [None]*len(semesters), 'label': 'Baseline'}` and skip Nones in overview aggregation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/overview does not defensively handle heterogeneous student docs; it assumes every student has performance.series[0..len(semesters)-1]. Fragile.

server.py _new_student_doc / add_student create students without performance/baseline/writing_features/submission_behavior/semesters fields, but list_students projection excludes those. However /api/overview reads performance and blows up. Contract between engine.recompute() output shape and overview.py aggregation is not enforced.
server.py: two @app.on_event handlers still use deprecated startup/shutdown API (carried over from iter 1).
student_engine.recompute() output shape is not documented/type-hinted — a Pydantic model or TypedDict would prevent this kind of shape drift.
import_utils.parse_upload accepts arbitrary CSV — no size limit / row cap; potential DoS surface (low priority for demo).

success_rate.backend: 100% on new-feature endpoints (13/13) but /api/overview regression is a CRITICAL side-effect (dashboard broken)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of new-feature flows verified (Add / Import / Preview / Commit / Record / Upload); Dashboard broken due to backend /overview 500

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed students via POST /api/students and POST /api/students/import/commit with unique STU-TEST-*, STU-IMP-*, STU-CMT-*, STU-REC-*, STU-AUD-* ids. Not cleaned up; safe because ids are UUID-suffixed. Note: these newly-added students trigger the /api/overview 500.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New reviewer flows fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_reviewer_data_mgmt.py (13 tests, ~9s). Existing iter-1 suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still works. Known critical regression: /api/overview 500 whenever any student without full performance.series is in DB — verify after main-agent fix by hitting /api/overview after POST /api/students and expecting 200. Frontend Dashboard sits on skeletons until /overview is fixed; Students, Student Profile, Import modal, and record flows are all functional. Do NOT upload records onto Arjun (STU-2024-1001) — his profile uses curated analytics without academic_records.
rca of the issue: server.py /api/overview iterates i in range(len(semesters)) and reads student['performance']['series'][i] for every student. Students created via the new reviewer endpoints (add_student, import/commit, import/demo, _new_student_doc) go through _recompute_and_store -> student_engine.recompute(), which returns a performance dict whose 'series' length equals the number of semesters the student actually has records for — typically 1-3, not 5. When /api/overview loops i=0..4, perf[3] or perf[4] raises IndexError, returning 500. Reproduce: (1) POST /api/auth/demo, (2) POST /api/students {'student_id':'STU-BUG-1','full_name':'X'}, (3) GET /api/overview -> 500. Mitigation options: (a) in server.py overview, replace `dev = abs(perf[i] - base) / base * 100 if base else 0` with `dev = (abs(perf[i] - base) / base * 100) if (base and i < len(perf) and perf[i] is not None) else 0` and skip when out-of-range; (b) in student_engine.recompute() pad performance.series with the current-semester value (or None) to always equal len(semesters); (c) at _new_student_doc creation time, initialize performance = {'series':[None]*NUM_SEMESTERS,'label':'Baseline'} and have overview treat None as 'no contribution'.
